column1: # THE iq17-* RUNS' KNOWN DIVERGENCES FROM REAL SAP IQ 17.1 (IqParity.divergences; tools/iq-oracle/README.md, "The
# live IQ"). IQ island, landing 4 (WP1), 2026-10-14: real IQ 17.1 became the oracle of the iq17-* profiles, and these
# runs FAIL (a wrong answer), are a BUG (an answer where IQ raises an error) or an ERROR (an error where IQ answers),
# because lite follows SQL Anywhere's semantics where IQ's engine differs. Each is listed, not hidden, with its cause
# (measured on the live IQ by the corpus run of 2026-10-14, iqbuild/iqlive_corpus/report.md, and this snap).
# THE GUARD-FILE RULE (AGENTS.md; docs/FOUNDATIONS_PLAN.md §0.4): both IQ lanes fail on a FAIL, BUG or ERROR not
# listed here for their lane (a run SQL Anywhere judges may never be listed), and on a listed run that no longer
# diverges in a lane it lists (it PASSes, or is refused, or both error, or is skipped, or is gone): the list only
# shrinks. An entry is added only in a block under a dated comment naming the task that measured it; a fix removes
# its entries, and a cause no entry names any more.
# Lines: cause<TAB>id<TAB>what it is, then run<TAB>run key<TAB>cause id<TAB>lanes.

column3: integer arithmetic past a BIGINT: IQ's engine widens to a NUMERIC (BIGINT + 1 a NUMERIC(20,0), BIGINT * BIGINT a NUMERIC(39,0)), lite keeps a BIGINT, whose overflow the database raises; and IQ types by its data's range (k * 2 over small values a SMALLINT, its SUM a BIGINT) where lite types by the declared types' (IQ island, 2026-10-15: below a BIGINT lite widens as IQ does, 28 runs fixed)

the name IQ's engine gives an unaliased expression (its spelling, its parentheses, its case) is not SQL Anywhere's, which lite follows (WP2 item 3; IQ island, 2026-10-16: a grouped query's items, named by their own spelling under IQ's engine, fixed -- 8 runs)

the IQ engine's other restrictions lite does not raise: a column or a non-constant expression in an IN list, a scalar subquery outside the top-level select list, ORDER BY a negative constant (WP2 item 4; IQ island, 2026-10-16: an alias of a subquery read in WHERE, GROUP BY or HAVING raised -- 2 runs)
IQ 17.1's parser rejects TOP (expr), START AT (expr) and TOP ALL (-131), which lite reads (WP2 item 7)
two LISTs ordered differently: IQ answers with one order for both, where lite raises SQL Anywhere's -904 (WP2 item 6)

LOCATE's start under IQ's engine: a large one is its -1009145 ("cannot be big integer for non-LOB data"), which lite answers (WP2 item 8; IQ island, 2026-10-15: the other non-string inputs -- a number or a date given to LEFT, SUBSTRING, UPPER, the TRIMs, REPLACE, STUFF, LIKE, an untyped NULL in arithmetic, a DATE's time -- are refused with IQ's codes, IqFunctions.iqEngineArguments)
IS UNKNOWN over NOT IN of a subquery holding NULL: IQ's engine answers otherwise (WP2 item 9)
blank padding with a tab: IQ's engine pads the shorter string with blanks before comparing (WP2 item 10)
EXP's underflow is NULL in IQ 17.1's front end, 0 in SQL Anywhere 17's (WP2 item 10)

IQ's own defects (WP5): EXISTS over an aggregate subquery is false where no row matches; the internal error -1006000 for ISNULL(LEFT(...)) beside a CASE of SUBSTRING; (IQ island, 2026-10-16) a filter of the null-supplying side of a LEFT JOIN inside a windowed derived table, or an outer join's condition on it, applied below its window functions (a RANK or a COUNT(*) OVER () of the filtered rows)
a DOUBLE beyond the largest is NULL under IQ's engine, which the island answers; Postgres raises its own float8 overflow before the island's test can read the infinity

Snowflake computes a select list's items for the rows TOP, START AT or a DISTINCT TOP keeps only, so IQ's error in a row they drop (a zero divisor) is not raised there, where IQ, SQL Anywhere and DuckDB compute every row's (the IQ scale program, 2026-10-23: the Snowflake lane)

a SUM, a window's or a scalar subquery's, over a derived table's aggregate column (WITH s AS (SELECT k, SUM(n) AS sn ... GROUP BY k) SELECT sn / SUM(sn) OVER () FROM s): IQ's engine types it far wider than over a column (a NUMERIC(8,2) sum's total is a NUMERIC(23,2), a MAX's of a NUMERIC(7,2) divides as one of 20 digits, a COUNT's 35, an INTEGER sum's a NUMERIC(29,0)), by a rule not measured yet (p + 15 fits all but the INTEGER sum's); lite counts it as over a column, so the quotient has fewer places (the IQ scale program, 2026-10-25)

Postgres runs a FULL JOIN only on a merge- or hash-joinable condition (an equality of columns): a non-equi or an OR condition is its error ("FULL JOIN is only supported with merge-joinable or hash-joinable join conditions"), where IQ, DuckDB and Snowflake answer (the IQ scale program, 2026-10-25)

a SUM of a SUM IQ's engine casts to a NUMERIC its rows' estimate sizes (INT64(11,2) for a SUM of a NUMERIC(10,2)'s SUM over a cross join's fan-out), raising -1009145 where the value passes it, its own limit; lite answers the sum, and the AVG of it (the IQ scale program, 2026-10-26: tpcds-6742's shape)
